name: quoxagent-fleet
description: Manage your distributed QuoxAgent agent fleet. Monitor host health, execute remote commands, track resource usage, and coordinate tasks across all your servers from one dashboard.
shortDescription: Distributed agent management and remote execution.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Remote command execution with audit trail

fleetDashboard.name: Fleet Dashboard
fleetDashboard.description: See all connected agents, their status, and resource usage in one view.

remoteExecution.name: Remote Execution
remoteExecution.description: Execute commands on any host with full audit trail via AEE protocol.

resourceMonitoring.name: Resource Monitoring
resourceMonitoring.description: Track CPU, memory, disk, and network across all agents.

agentDeployment.name: Agent Deployment
agentDeployment.description: Deploy QuoxAgent agents to new hosts with one click.

jobTracking.name: Job Tracking
jobTracking.description: View job history, status, and output for executed commands.

claudeSessions.name: Claude Sessions
claudeSessions.description: Track Claude API sessions running on remote agents.

healthChecks.name: Health Checks
healthChecks.description: Automatic agent health monitoring with connection status.

notes.important: QuoxAgent Fleet provides the dashboard integration. The QuoxAgent Collector and Agent components are separate installations. See QuoxAgent documentation for setup.

quickActions.label: Agent Status
quickActions.prompt: List all QuoxAgent instances with their status, version, and last heartbeat

quickActions.label: Active Tasks
quickActions.prompt: Show all active tasks across QuoxAgent fleet
